_comment: Copy to ~/.harness-hooks/config.json and fill in for this machine. Keys are environment variable names; a real environment variable wins. Values may use ~ and %VAR%/$VAR. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
CLAUDE_GPT_REVIEW_ROOTS: <parent folder of the repositories under the GPT review gate>
HARNESS_JUDGE_CMD: <absolute path of the claude CLI used by citation_judge>
